title: China: AI Governance Principles Released (Library of Congress, Global Legal Monitor, Sept 9, 2019)
notes: Library of Congress (Law Library, Global Legal Monitor), Laney Zhang, 2019-09-09. MOST published 2019-06-17 Governance Principles for a New Generation of AI: Develop Responsible AI, by New Generation AI Governance Expert Committee. 8 principles: harmony/friendliness, fairness/justice, inclusiveness/sharing, respect for privacy, security/controllability, shared responsibility, open cooperation, agile governance. Framework + action guidelines. US Gov work, CC0. Cross-confirms source 87 (MOST full text).
